gloss: sense of orientation (to time, place, person)

definitions.gloss: orientation; awareness of time, place, and person
definitions.explanation: The cognitive ability to know what day it is, where one is, and who is around. A standard clinical assessment item; its loss ({見当識障害|けんとうしきしょうがい}) is a hallmark of dementia and other cognitive impairment.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{見当識|けんとうしき}が{低下|ていか}してきた。
examples.english: My grandmother's orientation has been declining.

examples.japanese: {患者|かんじゃ}の{見当識|けんとうしき}を{確認|かくにん}した。
{認知症|にんちしょう}の{初期|しょき}{症状|しょうじょう}として、{見当識|けんとうしき}{障害|しょうがい}が{現|あらわ}れることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Disorientation often appears as an early symptom of dementia.

notes:
Compound of {見当|けんとう} (rough estimate; bearings) + {識|しき} (consciousness; recognition). Almost exclusively a clinical/medical term — not used about day-to-day getting lost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見当識|けんとうしき}{障害|しょうがい}: disorientation; orientation impairment
- {時間|じかん}/{場所|ばしょ}/{人物|じんぶつ}に{対|たい}する{見当識|けんとうしき}: orientation to time / place / person
- {見当識|けんとうしき}が{低下|ていか}する: orientation declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方向感覚|ほうこうかんかく}: sense of direction — about navigating space, not clinical awareness
- {意識|いしき}: consciousness — broader; whether one is awake and aware
